hints:

FROM Product_Suppliers
GROUP BY Product_Suppliers.supplier_id
HAVING AVG(CAST(total_value_purchased AS REAL)) > 50000
   OR AVG(CAST(total_value_purchased AS REAL)) < 30000;

   OR AVG(CAST(ps.total_value_purchased AS REAL)) < 30000;
